research_question: Does the prospectively selected NYC October 8 fixed-NegRisk event expose any complete long-only direction-independent package with side-specific Gamma acquisition evidence below its conditional payout floor and positive after exact configured fees plus one adverse tick per leg?
endpoint_classification: Public unauthenticated read-only Gamma exact event metadata GET, same published endpoint and no account/order operation as the retained source-selected daily-series captures

payoff_basis.all_yes: One YES on each exhaustive mutually exclusive outcome pays one pUSD in the common-rule valid-resolution model.
payoff_basis.binary_straddle: Same-market YES plus NO pays one pUSD in that model.
payoff_basis.k_no: NO on k distinct mutually exclusive outcomes has a k-minus-one pUSD floor in that model.
payoff_basis.basis_completeness: Screen all-YES, every same-market straddle and exact optimal NO cardinality frontiers; positive-cost YES additions that do not cover a selected proper NO subset cannot improve its minimum payout.

economics.no_acquisition: Conservative one minus direct YES bestBid; no midpoint/outcomePrices admission
economics.missing_price_rule: Incomplete, never a free leg; do not request missing prices
economics.gamma_role: Conditional rejection-only source diagnostic, never executable profit or owned fills
economics.stress_gate: Strict positive floor at five common shares after exact configured taker fee and one adverse tick per leg; absent fee schedule admits zero only when feesEnabled=false and feeType is empty
economics.selection_rule: Retain all-YES, every binary straddle and every optimal gross/fee-tick k-NO frontier; deterministic source cost then numeric market-ID ordering, strongest feasible stressed row only after every row is fixed
economics.source_rule_limit: Metadata eligibility is not complete legal/on-chain settlement proof. Source descriptions, station, whole-day boundaries, complete bins and fallback identity must be audited before any candidate may authorize a separate book contract. A positive preliminary subtotal alone does not pass that qualification.

transport.timeout_note: Between-chunk elapsed budget is not a hard wall-time guarantee for a blocking socket read

retry_policy: This exact event GET is one-use. Do not refetch, alias, change count, repair missing rows, reprice or select a sibling after the result. A rejection is terminal absent material economic/rule evidence. Only a positive stressed diagnostic plus complete independent rule/adapter qualification can authorize one separately frozen exact book batch.
prohibited_shortcuts: No rendered event or price-bearing search before capture
No adaptive event date count cardinality cost or family changes
No Gamma price as executable acceptance or missing leg as zero
No book fee account credential order fund transaction on-chain or protected request from a failed or unqualified source gate
No current profit inferred from a historical paper, fee promotion, expired campaign or favorable regression slope
